readme:
# TikTok User Unique ID API

Look up a TikTok account's unique identifier using the profile link in `url`. This endpoint resolves web profile links to direct user account identifiers.

## Use cases

- Resolve a TikTok profile link to a unique user handle or identifier.
- Normalize web profile URLs for downstream TikTok account tracking.
- Validate and link public TikTok creator profiles in marketing databases.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/tiktok/web/unique-id" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"url": "https://www.tiktok.com/@tiktok"}'
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | string | Yes | User homepage link |

## Notes

- `url` requires a complete TikTok user profile homepage link.

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls, including lookups whose target does not exist, are not charged.

## Related APIs

- [TikTok Video IDs from URLs (Batch)](/model/tiktok/web/all-aweme-id): Resolves and extracts TikTok video IDs from a list of video URLs.
- [TikTok User Sec User ID Extractor](/model/tiktok/web/all-sec-user-id): Returns a list of sec_user_id identifiers corresponding to TikTok user profile URLs.
- [TikTok Profile Unique IDs](/model/tiktok/web/all-unique-id): Resolves a batch of TikTok user homepage links to retrieve their corresponding unique identifiers.
